# Sarankumar G

> Sarankumar G (also written Saran, Sarankumar or Saran Kumar) is a mobile, web and full-stack developer based in Kovilpatti, Tamil Nadu, India. He works full time as a full-stack developer and is open to freelance projects. He builds fast, private, offline-first apps with Flutter and React, and the backends behind them with Supabase, Firebase, Node.js and FastAPI. He works with clients anywhere, remotely.

Website: https://sarankumar.dev
Email: sarankumarg.in@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/Sarandjj
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarankuamr-g
Time zone: Asia/Kolkata (IST, UTC+5:30)
Full text of every page: https://sarankumar.dev/llms-full.txt

## What he does

- Mobile apps for Android and iOS from one Flutter codebase, offline-first, ready for the stores.
- Web apps in Flutter Web or React, and static sites with Astro.
- Backend and data: Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Row Level Security, Edge Functions), Firebase, Node.js with Express, FastAPI (Python).
- Rescue work: auditing slow or buggy Flutter apps, performance fixes, tests and cleanup.

## Blog posts

- [Flutter web and SEO: why my portfolio is plain HTML now](https://sarankumar.dev/blog/flutter-web-seo): why a Flutter web site is hard for search engines to read, and what moving to static HTML with Astro changed.
- [Three ways to put a live Flutter app demo on a portfolio](https://sarankumar.dev/blog/live-flutter-demos-with-fake-data): how FinWise, Nirai and NallHub run in the browser with made-up data, from a seeded local database to an in-memory fake Supabase backend.
- [7 things to have ready before you hire an app developer](https://sarankumar.dev/blog/before-you-hire-an-app-developer): a checklist for clients: the goal, the users, the must-have screens, the accounts to own, and who decides.
- [Why you should never put an API key inside a mobile app](https://sarankumar.dev/blog/never-put-api-keys-in-a-mobile-app): keys in an app can be extracted; Coin18 keeps them on a small Node.js server that also caches.
- [Offline-first sync to Google Drive with no backend](https://sarankumar.dev/blog/nirai-drive-sync-no-backend): how Nirai merges changes between devices through one JSON file in the user's own Drive, with a field-by-field merge and tombstones.
- [Soft deletes in Drift: SQLite's onDelete does not fire on UPDATE](https://sarankumar.dev/blog/finwise-soft-delete-drift): why tombstones switch off foreign-key cascades and how FinWise rebuilt them.
- [I built my own document scanner, then went back to ML Kit](https://sarankumar.dev/blog/clean-scanner-ml-kit): a real-phone comparison that decided between a custom edge detector and Google's scanner.

## Projects (case studies)

- [Sports Booking App](https://sarankumar.dev/projects/sports-booking-app): sports app for booking courts, joining matches and managing player profiles, live on Google Play and the App Store. Flutter, Riverpod, Firebase, Razorpay. Sarankumar developed the Flutter app and its Firebase, push-notification and payment integrations.
- [Weather Monitoring App](https://sarankumar.dev/projects/weather-monitoring-app): weather and environmental monitoring app associated with a government environmental authority, live on both stores. Flutter, GetX, Firebase, Google Maps. Sarankumar worked on specific Flutter features: data dashboards, station maps and push alerts.

- [FinWise](https://sarankumar.dev/projects/finwise): offline-first personal finance tracker with trips and group expense splitting. Flutter, Riverpod, Drift, Supabase. Has a live web demo with sample data.
- [NallHub](https://sarankumar.dev/projects/nallhub): white-label school management app for private schools in Tamil Nadu, with admin, teacher and parent roles, in English and Tamil. Flutter, Supabase.
- [Nirai](https://sarankumar.dev/projects/nirai): to-do app that keeps data on the phone and syncs to the user's own Google Drive. No server, no account.
- [Coin18](https://sarankumar.dev/projects/coin18): market-research app for coins, charts and a watchlist, with its own Node.js API that caches data and hides provider keys.
- [Clean Scanner](https://sarankumar.dev/projects/clean-scanner): offline document and ID scanner with no ads, no login and no network for core features.

The Sports Booking App and the Weather Monitoring App are live client apps on Google Play and the Apple App Store. The other five apps are his own and are currently in development. Each case study states what works today and what is still planned.
